parameter.name: Playlist name
parameter.placeholdervalue: Enter a name for your dynamic playlist

parameter.name: Never stop
parameter.tooltipvalue: When all matching tracks have been played, the history and cache are deleted so that these tracks can be played again. You will end up with a dynamic playlist that will not stop playing as long as tracks are found that match the search criteria.

parameter.name: Request parameter 1 from user
parameter.data: artist=Artist,genre=Genre,multiplegenres=Multiple Genres,decade=Decade,multipledecades=Multiple Decades,year=Year,multipleyears=Multiple Years,virtuallibrary=Virtual Library,playlist=Static Playlist,multiplestaticplaylists=Multiple Static Playlists,addedtime=Last added time,lastplayed=Last played time

parameter.name: Request parameter 2 from user
parameter.data: artist=Artist,genre=Genre,multiplegenres=Multiple Genres,decade=Decade,multipledecades=Multiple Decades,year=Year,multipleyears=Multiple Years,playlist=Static Playlist,multiplestaticplaylists=Multiple Static Playlists,addedtime=Last added time,lastplayed=Last played time

parameter.data: 1=Most played first (avg. count),2=Least played first (avg. count),3=Most played first (total count),4=Least played first (total count)

parameter.name: Include genres
parameter.data: select genres.id,genres.name,genres.namesearch from genres order by namesort asc

parameter.name: Exclude genres
parameter.data: select genres.id,genres.name,genres.namesearch from genres order by namesort asc

parameter.name: Only include tracks from selected album artists
parameter.data: select contributors.id,contributors.name,contributors.namesearch from tracks,contributor_track,contributors where tracks.id=contributor_track.track and contributor_track.contributor=contributors.id and contributor_track.role in (1,5) group by contributors.id order by contributors.namesort asc

parameter.name: Exclude tracks from selected album artists
parameter.data: select contributors.id,contributors.name,contributors.namesearch from tracks,contributor_track,contributors where tracks.id=contributor_track.track and contributor_track.contributor=contributors.id and contributor_track.role in (1,5) group by contributors.id order by contributors.namesort asc

parameter.name: Only include tracks from selected composers
parameter.data: select contributors.id,contributors.name,contributors.namesearch from tracks,contributor_track,contributors where tracks.id=contributor_track.track and contributor_track.contributor=contributors.id and contributor_track.role = 2 group by contributors.id order by contributors.namesort asc

parameter.name: Exclude tracks from selected composers
parameter.data: select contributors.id,contributors.name,contributors.namesearch from tracks,contributor_track,contributors where tracks.id=contributor_track.track and contributor_track.contributor=contributors.id and contributor_track.role = 2 group by contributors.id order by contributors.namesort asc

parameter.name: Exclude works
parameter.data: select works.id,works.title,works.titlesearch from works join tracks on works.id = tracks.work where tracks.work is not null group by works.id order by works.titlesort asc

parameter.name: Limit to currently selected virtual library on player
